body.input: Call the generate_image tool with prompt='wakeup-e2e-test' and callbackMode='wakeUp'. Phase 1: You will get a taskId immediately — reply PHASE1_OK taskId=<value>. Phase 2: You will be automatically revived when the image is ready. The result will contain an imageUrl OR a rendered markdown image. When revived, confirm an http/https image URL is present in the result. End with WAKEUP_OK if the image URL appeared, or WAKEUP_FAILED: <reason> if not.
